is_staff.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    public.current_user_role() in ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'tech', 'sales', 'cashier', 'viewer'),
    false
  )
$function$
